```{r}
source("R/packages.R")
source("R/functions.R")
set.seed(2026)

tar_load(pbp_possessions)
```

```{r}
possessions <- pbp_possessions %>%
  group_by(game_id, possession_id, team_id) %>%
  summarise(
    points_scored = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
    events = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
